description: Ancricket bat and ball during a County Championship National Over 60s 1st XI Cup game on 6 August 2019, between Essex [1] and Wales [2] . The game was part of the South area elimination stage for the 2019 National 60+ / 70+ County Cricket Championship , and played at Bishop's Stortford Cricket Club on Cricketfield Lane in Bishop's Stortford , Hertfordshire , England.
